static_observations: Connectivity uses four integer slots per element.
Generate directed successive edges, including fourth-to-first. Skip that last edge when the first and fourth node IDs coincide.
Pair an edge only with a later edge of reversed direction. Clear the matched edge's first node and omit the current edge.
Compact surviving edges in original order.
Walk unused edges in order. Start each output chain at the first unused edge and repeatedly choose the first later edge whose start equals the current endpoint.
Chain lookup always begins after the outer starting-edge index, not after the most recently followed edge.
Store one-based start/end ranges for each chain and zero separators in the node stream; replace the final separator with -1. An empty result writes -1 into the first stream slot.
The object consumer copies at most 100 chains into boundary groups and stores node counts at group+0, node pointers at group+8.
The object then updates total boundary counts and dependent arrays through 0x140165d30 and 0x1401631e0.
